THIS (among other things) is why I patiently searched for FIVE YEARS to find a 30+ year old, mint condition, low mileage truck. 



It won't spy on me to collect and sell my data. It can't be disabled from a.satellite. I actually OWN it (as opposed to just having a "license to operate" where the mfr. retains ownership for the life of the vehicle). If a taillight burns out it won't cost me $800 and need to be "recognized" by the truck or it won't start. I'll never have a monthly subscription fee for the heater to work. I'll never be stuck for two hours while it receives a "software update" from space. I can do a brake job on it without having to buy a $4000 scantool and an additional $2300 for the proprietary software. It will run another 225,000 miles easily with good maintenance (I won't live that long).  It won't need a rearend rebuild after 30K miles. It didn't cost me $85,000. 



All I have to worry about is the possibility that it could be "banned" and the eventual scarcity of parts (either by government edict or simply the passage of time. I have started stockpiling).
